responsibility: This header declares the RTL debug-value tracking support used to keep DEBUG_INSNs valid when registers die or expressions are rewritten. It defines the local/global data structures that record dead-register debug uses and their replacement debug temporaries, the policy enum controlling where debug temps are inserted relative to an insn, and the APIs for collecting uses, creating debug temps, and propagating substitutions through debug insns.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/valtrack.cc, which implements the RTL-side transformations that preserve debug values, this header defines and declares the bookkeeping interface for that machinery: the dead_debug_global/local/use structures, the debug_temp_where policy enum, and the exported helper routines.
